hero.title: Customers aur Verified Professionals ke beech bharosa banana
hero.subtitle: KaunBatayega logon ko apne shehar mein legal, business, government aur zaroori services ke liye verified professionals dhoondhne mein madad karta hai.
hero.copy: Platform ka maksad service discovery ko simple, transparent aur dependable banana hai, saath hi serious professionals ko apna business badhane ke liye trusted jagah dena hai.

story.title: Local trust problem ka practical jawab.
story.copy: Kai Indian cities mein log abhi bhi professionals ko references, calls, shop boards ya scattered online listings se dhoondhte hain. Yeh tareeka kabhi kaam karta hai, lekin customers ko credentials, process, documents aur reliability par clarity nahi milti.

items.title: Problem
items.copy: Legal help, GST, property papers aur government documentation jaise important kaam random contact number se zyada confidence maangte hain.

items.title: Hum kyun hain
items.copy: KaunBatayega verified professionals, structured profiles aur simple discovery ko ek trusted experience mein laane ke liye banaya gaya.

items.title: Customers ke liye
items.copy: Customers providers compare kar sakein, service categories samajh sakein aur zyada clarity ke saath shuru kar sakein.

items.title: Providers ke liye

faq.title: KaunBatayega ke common questions.
faq.copy: Customers aur professionals ke liye clear answers.

items.question: KaunBatayega kya hai?
items.answer: KaunBatayega ek trusted service marketplace hai jo customers ko legal, GST, property, documentation, government aur essential service categories mein verified professionals discover karne mein madad karta hai.

items.question: Providers verify kaise hote hain?
items.answer: Providers profile information aur required documents submit karte hain. Admin team identity, professional details aur documents review karne ke baad approval deti hai.

items.question: Provider kaun ban sakta hai?
items.answer: Lawyers, CAs, GST consultants, property consultants, documentation experts, insurance advisors, electricians, government consultants aur serious service professionals apply kar sakte hain.

items.question: Customers connect kaise karenge?
items.answer: Customer-side access prepare ho raha hai. Public site abhi services explain karta hai jab verified provider network build ho raha hai.

items.question: Registration free hai?
items.answer: Provider account creation onboarding ke liye available hai. Future paid plans ya upgrades activation se pehle clearly dikhaye jayenge.

items.question: Kya providers multiple services offer kar sakte hain?
items.answer: Haan. Providers registration ke time relevant categories aur services select kar sakte hain, jo verification aur admin review ke subject hain.

items.question: Verification mein kitna time lagta hai?
items.answer: Complete aur readable documents submit hone ke baad verification usually 24-48 hours mein complete hota hai.

items.question: Kya profile update kar sakte hain?
items.answer: Haan. Account onboarding ke baad providers dashboard se profile details update kar sakte hain.
